title: Unit checks
subtitle: History of OK / Not OK checks via QR. Manage checklists under Teams. First enable unit checks on category and unit.

validation.external_unit_not_found: No unit found with this external ID.
validation.unit_checks_disabled: Unit checks are not enabled for this unit.

lists.title: Checklists
lists.lead: Create checklists here (optionally linked to a team; starters for cleaning, technical and security) and assign them per unit via Locations → edit unit. On the unit QR the points appear under Unit check; for OK all points must be ticked.

fields.name: Name
fields.items_hint: Write each checklist item on a new line.
fields.team_hint: Shared checklists are available everywhere. Team checklists only for units whose category is linked to that team.

errors.translation_import_item_too_long: A translated checklist item is too long.
